- ACORD 25 certificate showing current limits and policy periods

I have cc'd our broker Mark Turner who will coordinate endorsement wording with your carrier if we get a positive on form acceptance.

Thanks —
Sarah Bell

Sarah —

Appreciate the clear list. I'm attaching our current redline of the MSA and a short certificate/endorsement checklist for your broker to review. High-level response below; legal is looped for final confirmation:

- ACORD 25: yes, we can provide current certificate; we will request endorsement evidence as a follow-up.
- Additional Insured: we can provide AI endorsement on CGL; need legal to confirm whether "primary & non-contributory" phrasing is acceptable across carriers.
- Waiver of subrogation: typically supported on GL/Auto — will confirm for E&O/cyber with carrier.
- E&O retroactive date: we generally can provide retroactive date equal to policy inception or earlier; legal to confirm if claims-made scoping is required.
- Cyber limit: we have a $3M aggregate product available for customers on dedicated contracts; procurement will confirm if this is acceptable for the Order Form.
- 30-day notice: standard request; we will ask our broker to include.

Next steps I propose:
1) I will send the attached MSA redline to our legal ops (Kimberly) for fast review of the endorsement language (esp. primary/non-contrib + retro date).
2) Mark (cc'd) — can you coordinate with your carrier to see if they can issue the AI endorsement form and a signed waiver? If carrier requires different form numbers (CGs), please advise.
3) Once we have the endorsements, procurement (Aditya) will complete the Order Form and routing.

Attaching: Redwood_MSA_redline_v3.docx (redline), Acme_Certificate_Request.pdf (template)

Thanks,

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, Mark Turner <mark.turner@jtb-broker.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Insurance evidence & endorsements for Redwood MSA

Team / Mark —

I reviewed Rachel's redlines and Sarah's spec. A few clarifications and recommended positions from Legal (summary):

- Additional Insured: require endorsement with equivalent to CG 20 10 (or CG 20 37/CG 20 10 combination) but explicitly add the contract-based language: "Redwood Inference Inc. agrees to add Acme Logistics, Inc. as Additional Insured on a primary and non-contributory basis with respect to liability arising out of Redwood's services under the Contract." If carrier pushes back, we will accept an endorsement showing primary/non-contrib in writing and a COI noting the same as interim evidence.

- Waiver of Subrogation: acceptable for GL and Auto. For Professional Liability (E&O) and Cyber, waiver depends on carrier acceptance; request written confirmation from broker.

- Retroactive date (E&O): Acme's requirement that retro date be "not later than contract start" is reasonable. We prefer to limit to "retroactive date no later than effective date of the policy providing coverage during the term of the Contract" — in practice we can usually align to contract start. If carrier requires a narrow retro date window we will escalate.

- Limits (for procurement): propose the following baseline to avoid further rounds:
   * General Liability: $5,000,000 per occurrence / $5,000,000 aggregate
   * Auto Liability: $2,000,000 combined single limit
   * Professional Liability (E&O): $5,000,000 per claim / aggregate; claims-made acceptable with retro date aligned to contract
   * Cyber/Privacy: $3,000,000 aggregate

- Notice & Rating: require 30 days' written notice of cancellation/non-renewal and carrier AM Best rating of A- or better (or equivalent).

Mark — please confirm whether the carrier can issue the AI endorsement on a primary & non-contributory basis and provide the endorsement form number and insurer name/rating. If there will be any exceptions or delays, flag them now so procurement can decide on temporary mitigations (escrow of funds, limited commencement).

If Mark can confirm the endorsement and retro date feasibility by EOD tomorrow, Aditya can route the Order Form and we can keep the signature timeline intact.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
